08c_1_cancel_and_survive.png: The term $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$ of the field equation in the diagonal frame, direction by direction (no sum) and summed (black). Left: the part of the coefficient of $\gamma^{(4)}$ proportional to $a_4'$, in units of $a_4'$; the three inflating directions $x_1, x_2, x_3$ (blue) give $+1/2$ each, the three deflating extra times $x_5, x_6, x_7$ (red) give $-1/2$ each, $x_4$ and $x_0$ (gray) give 0, and the sum is 0; the extra times also give $\frac14 b_4'/b_4$ each (not drawn), together $\frac34 b_4'/b_4$. Right: the coefficient of $\gamma^{(0)}$ in units of $H$; the same six directions give $+1/2$ each and the sum is $3$. Exact values from sympy, valid for all functions $a_4$, $b_4$ and every $H > 0$.
08c_2_pieces_along_history.png: Along the canonical history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ of the Kohn-Sham record ($A = H = 1$, a prescribed background) at $z = \pi/4$, against the time $x_4$. Left, logarithmic axis: four components of the spin connection of the diagonal frame; those of the inflating direction $x_1$ grow like $e^{a_4}$ (dashed, factor $H$, on solid, factor $a_4' = H = 1$), those of the extra time $x_5$ shrink like $e^{-a_4}b_4^{1/2} = e^{-x_4/3}$ (solid: the rate $r = a_4' - b_4'/(2b_4) = 1/3$). Right: the coefficient of $\gamma^{(4)}$ in $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$ summed over the three inflating directions (blue, $3a_4'/2$) and over the three extra times (red, $-3a_4'/2 + \frac34 b_4'/b_4$): both sums stay constant, their $a_4'$ parts cancel, and the sum (black) is the term $\frac34 b_4'/b_4 = H$ of the growing $b_4$.
08c_3_boost_size.png: The size $\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}(M^TM)/16}$ of the term $M = \gamma'^\mu\Omega'_\mu$ of the field equation in the frame boosted in the $(x_4, x_0)$ plane with rapidity $b = \beta x_4 + b_0$, on the history of the Revision record ($\frac34 b_4'/b_4 = H$) for $H = 1$; sizes in units of $H$. Left: against the rapidity rate $\beta$ at $x_4 = 0$, $b_0 = 0$; the diagonal frame ($\beta = 0$) gives $\sqrt{10}$, the size of $3H\gamma^{(0)} + H\gamma^{(4)}$, and the size $\sqrt{((6H - \beta)/2)^2 + H^2}$ falls to its smallest value $H$ at $\beta = 6H$, where only the part $H\gamma^{(4)}$ of the growing $b_4$ is left. Right: against the time $x_4$ (symmetric logarithmic axis) for $\beta = 0, 3H, 6H, 9H$; for $\beta = 6H$ the size is $\sqrt{\cosh 2b}$, never zero. The metric is the same in every one of these frames.
08c_4_heat_maps.png: The $16 \times 16$ matrix $\gamma^\mu\Omega_\mu$ of the field equation as a colour map (rows and columns numbered from 0; red positive, blue negative, white zero; entries in units of $H$, $H = 1$, time $x_4 = 0.3$, $b_0 = 0$, on the history of the Revision record, where $\frac34 b_4'/b_4 = H$). Left: diagonal frame, $3H\gamma^{(0)} + H\gamma^{(4)}$, sixteen entries equal to 3 and sixteen equal to $\pm1$. Middle: frame boosted with $\beta = 3H$, $\frac{3H}{2}(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(0)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(4)}) + H(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(4)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(0)})$ with $b = 0.9$. Right: frame boosted with $\beta = 6H$, only $H(\cosh b\,\gamma^{(4)} - \sinh b\,\gamma^{(0)})$ with $b = 1.8$: the part $3H\gamma^{(0)}$ is gone, the part of $b_4$ is not. Same metric, same field equation, different frames.
08c_5_curvature_maps.png: The spinor curvature $F_{x_1x_0} = \partial_1\Omega_0 - \partial_0\Omega_1 + \Omega_1\Omega_0 - \Omega_0\Omega_1$ as a $16 \times 16$ colour map (red positive, blue negative, white zero; units of $H^2$) at $H = 1$, $z = \pi/4$, $x_4 = 0.5$ along the history of the Revision record ($a_4 = x_4$); each panel has its own colour scale. Left: diagonal frame. Right: the frame boosted with $\beta = 6H$, in which the part $3H\gamma^{(0)}$ of the term $\gamma'^\mu\Omega'_\mu$ of the field equation is gone; there the curvature is $e^{-3}$ times the left one. Neither is zero: the curvature equals one quarter of the Riemann tensor contracted with two gammas, so no choice of frame can make the spin connection vanish. On this history both matrices have rank 8 and square zero.
